text:
Priya N.: Kicking off a concise handoff for the Efficiency Advisor MVP. Goal: give SEs clear recommendations for batching, prefix/KV caching, and safe quant suggestions, plus a light eval-alert alpha. Posting a proposed cut of scope + launch signals — please comment.
Carlos M.: Nice. Can we make the MVP focused on three customer patterns: high-throughput chat, short mobile prompts, and embedding pipelines? those capture most ops wins.
Priya N.: Agree. Proposed MVP features: 
1) Per-route batching config + "autoset" suggestion based on traffic histogram
2) Prefix/KV caching hints with suggested TTLs and miss-rate estimator
3) Quant recommendation engine that maps routes to profiles (no forced conversion)
4) Eval-alerts: alpha tier that raises warnings on regression (no auto-fallback yet)
Dana S.: Important: quant recs must include a recommended rollback plan and a small suite of regression tests customers can run. Also surface the expected cost delta in Console before enabling.
Victor: For autoset, what inputs do we use? traffic percentiles, token length distribution, and 95th p99 latency headroom? would help to sketch formula.
Priya N.: Autoset inputs: p50/p90 token length, requests/sec, current p95/p99 latency, and current CPU/GPU utilization sample. Output: recommended batch size and expected p99 delta. We'll surface a confidence score too.
Carlos M.: UX ask: make the estimator show both "expected cost savings" and "estimated quality risk" as a small textual blurb for SEs. e.g., "~12% cost down, low risk (conf 0.78)".
Dana S.: For eval-alerts alpha, propose these signals: concordance on golden prompts, latency regressions, and embedding cosine drift for embedding-heavy routes. Two severities: warning (ops ticket) and urgent (manual review).
Priya N.: Draft launch criteria suggestion: 
- Stability: internal synthetic workload p99 within 5% of baseline for 24h
- Correctness: quantized-run unit tests pass on a representative model family
- Observability: Console shows cost delta estimator for top 10 routes
- Pilot: at least one external pilot across mobile/chat/embeddings OR internal beta with production-like load
- Eval Alerts: alpha implemented and firing on internal eval sets
Victor: If pilots are optional for GA, define what "internal beta" means (traffic %, duration). I'd say 1% of traffic for 72 hours with A/B measurement.
Carlos M.: Acceptance metric: no more than 3% regression on user-visible metrics in pilot A/B, and rollback must be completed within 30 mins if breach detected.
Priya N.: Ops notes: Dedicated/Private customers should get opt-in toggles for auto-fallback; Hosted defaults to manual rollback until we have more data. Ops-bot, please confirm maintenance window for alpha rollout.
ops-bot: Maintenance window proposed: 2026-04-09 03:30 UTC. Reply with :thumbsup: to approve.
Dana S.: Action items: 
- Priya: publish MVP doc + owners (EOD Wed)
- Carlos: sample copy for Console econ/risk blurbs + two quick mockups (Mon)
- Victor: autoset heuristics sketch + formula (Tue)
- Dana: eval set list and A/B metric definitions (Tue)
- All: approve rollout window or flag blockers by EOD today
Priya N.: Thanks all. I'll push a short doc to https://redwood.internal/docs/efficiency-advisor-mvp and create a calendar invite for a 30min sync next week. :white_check_mark:
